label: Dewey Decimal Classification
scope_note: Library classification first published by Melvil Dewey in 1876, now maintained by OCLC. Main classes checked against Wikipedia's 'List of Dewey Decimal classes', which cites the OCLC DDC 23 summaries.

label: Computer science, information, and general works
Religion
scope_note: In DDC 23, divisions 220 to 280 (the Bible, Christianity, Christian practice, orders, theology, history and denominations) are devoted to Christianity, and 290 is 'Other religions'. Kept as a documented example of a single-tree scheme encoding one tradition's centre.
